title: Set skip_when_only on change checks in athena.toml
summary: Add `skip_when_only = ["docs/", "*.md"]` to the fmt, clippy and test checks under `[capabilities.change]` in athena.toml. Those checks are then skipped when a change touches only prose paths. The study capability is left alone, and a CHANGELOG note records the enablement.

defaults_applied.how: One config edit plus a changelog note.
The patterns and scope came from CHANGELOG.md and checks.rs, not from a question.
The skip rule is enforced by existing code in checks.rs, and the verifier runs the tests.
A comment in athena.toml explains the key for an outside reader.

assumptions: The prose-only patterns are "docs/" and "*.md", the pattern forms CHANGELOG.md documents.
All three change checks (fmt, clippy, test) get the skip, because none of them can fail on a docs-only change.
Study checks stay unskipped: the request names no scope and studies/ holds JSON claims that tests validate.
The parser and runner already landed, per CHANGELOG.md and crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, so no Rust change is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml gives each of the three [[capabilities.change.checks]] entries (fmt, clippy, test) a skip_when_only list containing only prose patterns, "docs/" and "*.md", with no Rust, Cargo, toml, or workflow paths.
The [[capabilities.study.checks]] entries and every other athena.toml key are unchanged, and athena.toml has a comment saying what the key does and why the patterns are prose-only.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased saying the key is now enabled in athena.toml, and no other file's behavior changes.
Run `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`; all pass. This shows athena.toml still parses, since the repository's tests load it.

out_of_scope: Changing the parser or runner in crates/
Enabling the skip for the study capability
Adding other skip patterns such as *.json or studies/
departures: Slightly higher verification probability and lower cost than the reference: this is a small config edit. The reading risk is the choice of patterns and which checks to cover.
